title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction. Layouts and live previews may contain errors; full visual acceptance in the Gameface client is pending.

Carousel SVG loading: fixed missing vector icons and class backgrounds by loading SVG directly through Gameface instead of the ResMgr binary image reader. Colour filenames containing # are URL-encoded, while existing PNG templates retain their original resource loader. SVG bytes are no longer serialized into carousel payloads.

Gameface graphics: redrew Account Manager action icons, excellence stars, carousel statistic icons and class backgrounds, and the clock background as SVG. Updated CSS and default template paths, added SVG support to carousel resource loading and packaged image previews, and replaced health-bar stripe textures with CSS. Removed the bundled PNG copies converted to SVG. Personal PNG templates remain supported; Flash images, 3D textures and detailed painted frames retain their original formats.

Vehicle health styles: added three transparent bar frames named Bastion, Vanguard and Ion, plus a compact Minimalist style with a thin dark outline and flat fill, selectable in the settings panel. Classic remains the default for existing and new profiles. Added saturation and brightness controls; bar colours continue to follow remaining health.

Vehicle health preview: the settings panel and battle HUD now share the same frame geometry, textures, typography and renderer. Fixed the old frame image path, kept positioning within the screen bounds and added a 0-100% sample health slider with 100%, 75%, 40% and 10% shortcuts. Sample health stays local to the preview and does not change saved settings or gameplay. Added labels for all 18 supported languages.

Vehicle health: the own health bar now runs in the Gameface battle HUD and its Flash view was retired. It can be dragged in battle with Ctrl and the position is saved to the same X/Y settings. Battle pages without the Gameface HUD (Halloween, Fort Rush) show no bar.

Marks of excellence: the star marks were invisible because the game font has no star glyphs; they are now drawn as images in the hangar and battle panels, the tech tree badge and the settings previews. The hangar panel title is visible again, the stars sit in one row, the nation name is localised, the gap to the next mark shows two decimals and the secondary text is larger at small scales.

Gameface text: arrows, triangles, check marks and other symbols missing from the game font were replaced by CSS shapes or font-safe characters in the settings window, the account manager and the marks panels. The trend shows only its sign and colour, and the replay estimate uses ~ instead of ≈.

Aiming countdown, shell flight time and penetration indicator: the three texts beside the crosshair now run in the Gameface battle HUD and their Flash views were retired. Templates, colours and offsets are unchanged; each text can now be dragged in battle with Ctrl and its offset is saved to the module's position settings. Battle pages without the Gameface HUD (Halloween, Fort Rush) show no text.

Crosshair texts settings: the penetration indicator page now has its template and X/Y position sliders, in all 18 languages, and the settings preview shows it centred on its offset like the battle text. The aiming countdown and flight time previews use the battle text size; their X/Y tooltips now give the offset in interface units instead of pixels, and the X tooltips mention dragging with Ctrl.
Crosshair texts logging: these texts log only their first visibility change at info level, so aiming across vehicles no longer fills game.log.

BREAKING: Hangar marks of excellence: the free draggable panel was replaced by a compact card under the native mission column, styled like the official mission rows. It shows the nation mark, the current mark in the selected rating colour and the stars; Show more opens a side panel with progress, damage targets, history and statistics. The position, lock, compact mode, scale and colour settings were removed.
BREAKING: the legacy xvm and XVMSymbol font aliases were removed from Flash and Gameface. Custom profiles must use dkm (or DriftkingsFont); the glyphs, including the rating symbol, are unchanged.

BREAKING: the legacy {{xvm-stat}} macro and the xvmScales.json statistics cache are no longer read. Use {{stat-available}} in custom templates; rating scales are cached as ratingScales.json and download automatically.
Native Halloween TAB player-name colours by rating were accepted in game on NA 2.4.1.1 #987, together with dkm fonts in markers, team panels and the carousel and {{stat-available}} in team panels.

Build and release tooling: machine-specific paths moved out of the build contract, builds accept EU, NA and ASIA clients, publication always requires a trusted signature, published tags are never moved, and the compiler and component manifest were simplified without changing the package contents.
Documentation: font and Halloween guides moved to docs/fonts and docs/halloween, historical guides retired and documentation conventions recorded.
Target WoT 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Preserve existing personal settings and keep stable 0.1.4 unchanged.
